title: Beatable structureless superflat
description: A datapck that allows you to beat minecraft in a superflat world with no structures or bonus chest
body:
a few years ago, I made a minecraft superflat world with some extra features and an end portal to make it beatable. but it wasn't a datapack, and it had structures in the nether and end.

this is the improved version.

when this datapack is loaded, regardless of the preset or world type selected, a superflat world with no structures or bonus chests will generate. Even so, it is in fact beatable.

the nether is also completely flat, just one layer of bedrock. the end is the regular nether

I added ways to get all the essential items to win the game. But most items are still gotten through regular structureless superflat. this is inspired by mogswamp's structureless superflat series, and the carpet sky additions mod.

this is the first version of this datapack. I will hopefully add all the other features as I learn more about datapack writing and get more ideas for items.

enjoy!

This is the first version

List of features:

·         Increased iron chance from zombies

·         Drowned spawn in the plains biome (mainly for tridents)

·         Chance for sand to drop from drowned

·         Small chance for sponge to drop from drowned when killed by player

·         Vindicators have a tiny chance to spawn, dropping emeralds for getting a sapling from the wandering trader

·         Guardians spawn in the end dimension in the biome “the end”

·         Coral/coral fans can be obtained from bonemealing underwater

·         Added recipe for coral blocks from coral in a 3x3 crafting grid

·         Stone/cobblestone mined in the end dimension drops cobbled deepslate instead (without silk touch)

·         Tuff can be crafted from deepslate and stone

·         Budding amethyst can be obtained by mining a diamond block surrounded by lava on all sides and above. It also has a tiny chance to drop from amethyst blocks.

·         Breaking an ender chest with obsidian on all sides drops an end portal frame (they are still unbreakable. Careful where you place them)

·         Carving a pumpkin has a tiny chance to drop sweet berries instead of pumpkin seeds. Also only drops one seed instead of 4.

·         Harvesting a beehive with shears has a tiny chance to drop a resin clump

·         All nether mobs (including fortress mobs) spawn in the nether wastes biome

·         Cats have a small chance to gift enchanted golden apples in the morning

·         Shulkers have a small chance to spawn in the end highlands biome in the end

·         Rabbits, frogs, and pandas have a small chance to spawn in the plains biome

·         Bamboo can be fished from any biome (not just jungle)

·         Swift sneak can be traded from villagers

·         Armorers, weaponsmiths, and toolsmiths have a small chance to gift a lava bucket

·         Farmers have a small chance to gift cocoa beans and nether wart and a tiny chance to gift mycelium

·         Fishermen have a small chance to gift hearts of the sea and turtle eggs

·         Bartering with piglins has a chance to give netherrack and a small chance to give a netherite upgrade

·         crimson nylium drops from netherrack surrounded by nether wart blocks

·         warped nylium drops from netherrack surrounded by glowstone blocks

·         Diamonds have a small chance to drop from wither skeletons

·         Ancient debris has a tiny chance to drop from zombified piglins

·         Creepers drop all music disks

·         A sculk shrieker spawns at coords 800 -50 800 for wardens

·         Tall flowers can be crafted from small flowers with bonemeal

 

Other features:

·         Protection enchantments can be on the same armor piece

·         Damage enchantments can be on the same weapon

·         Infinity and mending can be on the same bow
          All rescipes are unlocked
